cd /app && python3 - << 'PY'
import json,ipaddress
b=int(ipaddress.IPv6Network('2001:db8::/64').network_address)
t1=str(ipaddress.IPv6Address(b|1))
def row(**kw):
    d={"probe_id":"w/s/0/low-1/0","received_ms":1,"target":t1,"source":t1,"type":129,"code":0}
    d.update(kw); return json.dumps(d,separators=(',',':'))
lines=[]
lines.append('{"probe_id":"w/s/0/low-1/0","received_ms":NaN,"target":"%s","source":"%s","type":129,"code":0}'%(t1,t1))
lines.append('{"probe_id":"w/s/0/low-1/0","probe_id":"w/s/0/low-1/0","received_ms":1,"target":"%s","source":"%s","type":129,"code":0}'%(t1,t1))
lines.append(json.dumps({"probe_id":"w/s/0/low-1/0","received_ms":1,"target":t1,"source":t1,"type":129}))  # missing code
lines.append(json.dumps({**json.loads(row()),"probe_id":"x"*201}))  # too long probe id
lines.append(json.dumps({**json.loads(row()),"target":"2001:db9::1"}))  # address outside
lines.append(json.dumps({**json.loads(row()),"probe_id":"nope"}))  # unknown
lines.append(json.dumps({**json.loads(row()),"target":str(ipaddress.IPv6Address(b|2))}))  # target mismatch
lines.append(json.dumps({**json.loads(row()),"received_ms":100}))  # time (sent0 deadline100) received==deadline
lines.append(json.dumps({**json.loads(row()),"type":128,"code":0}))  # icmp
open('tmp/prec.jsonl','w').write('\n'.join(lines)+'\n')
